body: the tire pump is tied to the first-aid kit by a clipped lanyard. an empty loop shows where an identifying tag was cut off.
title: Tire pump with the unclosed tally

body:
Please keep the lesson room shut until the roadside spray test is over. The children can still hear the truck from the front room; their mother has paid for the whole week already.

A pencil line had been rubbed thin but not erased. I could still read enough of it to recognize what had been there first.

It may have started elsewhere; none of us saw the beginning. I only know what had reached this place before they closed the road.
title: Closed windows
